ValidationRule.description: Making sure if you have less credit and applying for Home or Vehicle, provide a collateral
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Approved"), (Applicant_Collateral_Count__c = 0), OR( AND( ($RecordType.DeveloperName = "Home_Loan_RT"), Requested_Amount__c >= 1000000, Risk_Score__c <= 5 ), AND( ($RecordType.DeveloperName = "Vehicle_Loan_RT"), Requested_Amount__c >= 1000000, Risk_Score__c <= 5 ) ) )
